name: Euclidier
_comment: MIDI generator with host-side glue (docs/PORTING.md classification 0): vst.json/module.json only feed tools/gen_vst.py for params.h + the skin. The plugin is euclidier_vst.cpp, built by this port's own build.sh: the vendored engine (../src, unmodified) is compiled in-process against rtmidi_stub/RtMidi.h, and notes go out through the plugin's own ALSA seq port 'Euclidier' -- no child process, no AddOns path.
